svg.title: Components of the resultant R
svg.desc: The x component of the resultant is Rx = Ax + Bx and its y component is Ry = Ay + By. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Add vectors by adding their components
Each component slides along its own axis and keeps its length. Rₓ and Rᵧ then fix the resultant’s
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
